parameters.query:
SELECT m.owner_id, m.daily_cap, coalesce(b.spent_today, 0) AS spent_today, g.id AS guardian_id,
  count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'rejected') AS rejected_5m,
  coalesce(sum(c.amount) FILTER (WHERE c.method = 'fund_job' AND c.status = 'success'), 0) AS funded_5m,
  count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.method = 'fund_job' AND c.status = 'success'
                      AND coalesce(r.settled_jobs, 0) < 3) AS new_seller_funds_5m
FROM mandates m
JOIN agents g ON g.owner_id = m.owner_id AND g.role = 'guardian' AND g.status = 'active'
JOIN profiles p ON p.id = m.owner_id
LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.account_id = p.near_account_id
LEFT JOIN chain_txs c ON c.owner_id = m.owner_id
      AND c.created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND c.method <> 'pause'
LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = c.job_id
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = j.seller_id
LEFT JOIN reputation r ON r.account_id = s.near_account_id
WHERE m.paused = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guardian_alerts ga
                   WHERE ga.owner_id = m.owner_id AND ga.resolved_at IS NULL
                     AND ga.created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes')
GROUP BY m.owner_id, m.daily_cap, b.spent_today, g.id;
